summary: Complete three separate dockyard approaches without firing. Identify Mateo, copy the ledger, take the prototype, survive his escape and extract all three in the car.
Chase the comms van in the Granger. Keep Gohan aboard and close enough to hack. At halfway the van crew fires back. Ice collects the drives at its rear doors, then everyone escapes in the Granger.
Guess locks the rail junction. Ice reaches the depot entrance and clears its guards. Gohan loads the weapons at the terminal. Guess delivers the actual Benson to the foundry.
Gohan cuts a surface-lot breaker. Ice clears the escort. Guess takes the chase car before Miller flees, stops him and collects his drive on foot.
Ice clears shore support. Guess launches a flare from the dinghy. Gohan stays aboard for the cove approach and capture: hold within 25m of Mateo for five seconds, then question him alive.
Gohan cuts the feeder. Ice enters the depot and defeats the response waves while Gohan works. Switch to Guess for crew boarding, then escape the police in the Granger.

The relay, the roof and the pickup lane are seen first. Ice reaches the antenna and clamps a visible sniffer; the manifests are read over it (two turbine engines, Paleto) and recorded as a copy held. The helicopter is shown coming, then Ice descends and boards Guess's pickup.

The two crates, the flatbed, the camera room and the sentries are seen first. Gohan's camera loop is a timed window. Ice clears the sentries; Guess drives the forklift to each crate and the lift onto the flatbed is staged and counted. The technical is shown coming; Ice handles it while Guess finishes. Ice rides in the flatbed, Gohan follows in the Granger. The crates are delivered to a temporary stash and recorded there for M09 and M10. Engine installation happens later in M11.

The convoy, the escort, Ice's rock and Ron's landing flat are seen first. Guess shadows the convoy in the Frogger, 60-220m away for 25 seconds. Ice stops the marked escort driver without destroying the truck; the colonel's vehicles are shown pulling away, which is why nobody chases him. Ice takes the unit from the cab on camera and Gohan reads it remotely: one checkpoint, once. Guess lands on the flat past the culvert, Ice boards, and the unit goes to the temporary drop point.

Starts at the connector stash: the same two crates M08 left are checked on the flatbed. Guess drives with Ice in the passenger seat; the bikes come; 35 mph with a 20-second grace. The Buzzard is shown coming and the tunnel mouth named as the firing window; the truck goes there and Ice steps out with the launcher. The police are lost and the engines are delivered to the Burro Heights shop, where M11 finds them.

The shop mid-work is seen instead of a briefing: the first crate open at the Granger's bay, the second on the flatbed. Guess fabricates motor mounts. Ice enters the Granger and holds 22-28 PSI with partial throttle for 12 seconds. With the engine shut down Gohan walks to the window with Berth 44, in the room, from the stage lines. The upgraded Granger is shown.

The hold number, the sub and the freighter are seen from the jetty first. Gohan pilots the sub to the submerged survey points, avoids patrol detection and completes the acoustic scan, seen as work at the hull; the patrol launches are shown once as the next problem; the sub returns to the jetty and the breach point is recorded. Reachable hull, not ready heist.

The three barges, the fuel workers and Ron's dark Granger at the slipway are seen first. Ice takes the water scooter, plants at all three barges without detection (workers can raise an alarm; they are not a fight); a launch turning into the basin is the shown reason to leave; the charges stay dark until Ice boards the Granger; the basin burning is a result view. Reduced patrols are recorded for M21.

The Besra with the pod, the apron guards, Ron below the hangar and Ice on the ridge are seen first. Ice clears the apron. Guess takes the jammer aircraft; Ice and Gohan leave the ridge in the Granger by road; the low route has radio cues; land and stop at McKenzie, where the pod is shown under the wing and recorded for M18 and M20. One radar window, not a blind Aegis.

The service access, a watchman's round, the cable point and Ron's Granger at the exit are seen first. Gohan reaches the maintenance access. Ice stuns the watchmen without killing them (they must survive to the end). Gohan splices the optical bypass at a real cable point, on camera; one gate answers as the acknowledgment; the crew leaves. Lock-gate access is recorded for M21, three copies.
Ice crosses the outer yard and clears the inner helipad. Guess takes the Cargobob, flies through the canyon below 60m and lands at Terminal Island.
Gohan works at every marked hull station. Guess tests the magnetic lock. Complete the radio check before staging the heist.
Gohan positions the Kraken in the channel, Guess lands the Cargobob, Ice positions and loads the hauler. All three keep their actual positions for the radio check.
As Gohan, descend in the Kraken, work at the breach, clamp all marked floats and surface at the target while avoiding depth-charge pressure.
Guess boards the Cargobob. Ice clears quayside gunners. Guess holds the aircraft at the container for the cable interaction and climbs with the attached load.
Gohan pilots the launch alongside the moving Cargobob, clears hostile boat crews and reaches the coastal breakwater. Guess continues inland by air.
Guess hovers over the Alamo drop point, releases the container, lands on shore and receives the foundry emergency call. Completion records the loss of Cypress.
Ice reaches the radar yard and clears squatters. Guess checks the three bays. Gohan starts the marked generator to establish the desert base.
Guess parks the recovery truck at the dry shoreline and works its cable while Ice defeats two response waves. Deliver the loaded truck before receiving the gold and cash.
Ice takes the bridge, destroys the fuel tanker from a safe distance and clears three assault waves. Parachute toward the extraction boat, then board it.
Guess boards the armed Lazer, destroys both marked spotter planes, then lands and stops the same aircraft at McKenzie.
Guess flies the stunt plane 12-60m from the Shamal for 12 seconds. A bounded transfer puts Ice in a real passenger seat. Take the ledger, bail out, parachute to Gohan and board the dinghy.
Gohan approaches the relay. Ice clears its guards. Gohan connects and continues the splice while Ice defeats two response squads. Guess extracts all three in the Granger.
Survey the rail transfer depot, clear its guards as Ice, operate the fuel valve, then deliver Guess's Phantom and its attached tanker to the bunker and unload while stopped.
Guess drives the loaded Dubsta 6x6 through two canyon-road markers under gunship pursuit. Ice and Gohan remain passengers. Deliver and unload the same vehicle at the bunker.

Sergei, the two crates and the guards are seen before the side door; Ron and Gohan are on the radio only. As Ice, clear the guards, take the codes from the living broker (a dead Sergei fails the job; he runs after), load both crates into Ice's own car on camera, and drive them to Ice's door. The reward is said as it works: the Pump Shotgun Mk II in Ice's locker and double rifle ammunition on every restock.

The roof approach, the server bay and a real terminal are seen first, with the check-in time said. As Gohan, reach the roof, stun both guards without killing them (they must survive to the end), inject the worm at the terminal on camera, then leave down the fire escape inside IT's 75-second trace. The result is municipal camera archive access, recorded as such; the dock recording and a witness are untouched. The locker reward is the Marksman Rifle.

KJ walks the prize crate on the coupe's tail and warns about the racers before the grid. As Guess, win the three-lap circuit; the rivals' guns are shown once as the change of plan; stop them or reach the finish; then drive the coupe and the prize to the Burro Heights chop bay, where the $25,000 and the race transmission become the crew's. KJ checks in over the phone.
As Ice, reach the quarry overlook, eliminate two marked marksmen, collect a radio at each nest and return to the approach.
As Gohan, take the dinghy to the buoy, exit and swim beside its service harness, install the interceptor, reboard and return to the water pickup beside shore.
As Guess, take the Phantom and attached aviation-fuel tanker through the canyon road under bike pursuit. Deliver both to McKenzie and unload while stopped.
